title: Consumer Protection Act 2007 (No. 19 of 2007), Part 3 (commercial practices: unfair, misleading, aggressive and prohibited practices)
citation: Consumer Protection Act 2007 (No. 19 of 2007) ss. 41-63, enacted 21 April 2007
evidence: eISB commencement table: "Ss. 1 - 47 1 May 2007 Consumer Protection Act 2007 (Commencement) Order 2007 ( S.I. No. 178 of 2007 ), art. 2" and "Ss. 50 - 102 1 May 2007 ... art. 2". Opened https://www.irishstatutebook.ie/isbc/2007_19.html on 2026-11-02.
notes: Records are Part 3 only (PART 3 heading to the line before PART 4), cut by position from each source. Ss. 48 and 49 (surcharges) are "Not yet commenced. Commencement order required under s.1(2)" in the eISB table, so Part 3 is in force except those two sections. Records: English as enacted (2007-05-01, eISB), English Revised Act updated to 24 November 2025 (Law Reform Commission; one current version), Irish official translation of the Act as enacted (achtanna.ie, kind translation, under IE-OIREACHTAS-TRANSLATION). The Revised Act is not up to date with S.I. No. 124/2026 (ie-si-124-2026, in force 2026-09-27), which its own banner says has changes not yet implemented. The Revised Act text includes the Commission's annotations. Consumer-claims umbrella for environmental claims; the Act does not mention greenwashing by name.
